strings: Outside Gnomeregan, salvaged Gyromechanic Gears are sought for a bold gnomish experiment. Inventors in Kharanos hope to use them to reverse leper gnome mutations.

Radiation swept through Gnomeregan as gnomes fought to purge the trogg invasion. Many survivors became mad, irradiated leper gnomes. Ozzie Togglevolt and Razzle Sprysprocket refuse to abandon their twisted kin, and have drawn up plans for the ambitious Recombobulator, a contraption meant to undo radiation's effects. Its prototype needs precise mechanisms that can withstand volatile pressure inside the machine, including Gyromechanic Gears and Restabilization Cogs. With local manufacturing gone after the fall of their capital, the inventors must salvage these delicate parts from hostile leper gnomes roaming Dun Morogh.

Razzle Sprysprocket in Kharanos needs Gyromechanic Gears as core mechanical parts for the Recombobulator. Along with Restabilization Cogs, they will go into the prototype machine designed to cure irradiated leper gnomes.

The Hand of Dextren Ward is a severed trophy taken from a condemned grave robber imprisoned within the Stormwind Stockade. Delivered to Darkshire, it serves as proof that frontier justice has finally been carried out against a man who desecrated the town's dead.

Before the town could execute him, Stormwind intervened, hauling the criminal away to the Stockade. For the grieving families of Darkshire, the Hand of Dextren Ward is physical proof that the defiler has met the execution he deserved, bypassing the House of Nobles' unwanted leniency.

Beyond satisfying local vengeance, demanding Ward's severed hand is an act of defiance by Councilman Millstipe against the crown. Duskwood feels abandoned by Stormwind's elite, who withhold military aid yet assert their own authority when it suits them. Executing a prisoner inside the capital's deepest dungeon and claiming his hand is a blunt reminder that the Darkshire Council will enforce its own laws when the House of Nobles fails them.

Handfuls of Stardust are shimmering, frosted coatings gathered from sparkling bushes in the southern wilderness of Ashenvale. Sourced from the ancient Ruins of Stardust, this powder possesses cooling natural properties prized by night elven healers treating intense fevers.

Pelturas Whitemoon, an anxious father in Astranaar, sought this powder on the advice of the herbalist Orendil Broadleaf.
